title: Ethical/epistemological fragment from an Epicurean treatise
policy: Explicit edition lem/corr readings drive display; all alternative spans and the unchanged source XML are retained. Unclear letters carry underdots; restorations have square brackets, omissions have angle brackets, and apograph-only readings have upper half brackets. Gaps, milestones, and physical textpart references stay explicit. Line break=no remains metadata. No normalization or text correction is applied to the source.
author: anonymous
token_policy: Offsets are Unicode code points in reading_text. Surface tokens retain editorial status and source span IDs. Gaps produce no tokens. Unclear, supplied, apograph, corrected, variant, gap-adjacent, and line-fragment tokens do not contribute to analysis_text or lexical frequencies. Null lemma/analysis means unattested, not automatic annotation.
